question: What supreme Eye of the two Śivas is honored as illumination and all-power?
premises: The Eye is described as illumination in nature
It belongs to the two Śivas and is supreme
inference: The supreme Eye of the two Śivas, luminous and all-powerful, is bowed to.
uncertainties: The identity of the two Śivas is not specified in this unit
plain_english: We bow to that supreme Eye of the two Śivas, whose nature is illumination and which possesses all power.
